0022600007.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder, 1-0 and first in the Northwest and the West, host the Denver Nuggets in their second game of the 2026-27 season, and Denver has not played a 2026-27 game yet. Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery), while Denver is missing Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and has Spencer Jones listed as day-to-day with a hamstring issue and a game-time decision. In the 2025-26 season series the Thunder won 3-1, and their most recent meeting, on April 10, 2026 in Denver, ended in a 127-107 loss for Oklahoma City; the teams have no 2026-27 games between them yet.
